name: Mare Care
author: aperture_tech
description: New ways to look after your mare. Be her farrier: pick out her hooves, trim and rasp them, nail on horseshoes in steel, silver, gold or rainbow, and oil them until they shine. Some mares pay in bits for it (never your wife). Brush her mane and tail until they sparkle, and brush her coat (built on modChad's Grooming mod). Tooth brushing and bathing are on the way. A free fan mod.
